purpose: Refine rejected attempt-02 into a geometrically explicit three-stage V9 blink source with half-close, closed and half-open heights that are visibly ordered at native 200x200.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole image reference for the fixed black vertical oval V9 eye identity, friendly ink weight and spacing

reference_policy: Use only the locked V9 source as image reference; rejected attempts are not image references.

geometry_contract.half_close: rounded black vertical capsule approximately 70 source pixels wide by 30-38 high; curved top and bottom; clearly compressed, not a full oval and not a flat cap
geometry_contract.closed: short rounded black curved stroke approximately 60-70 source pixels wide by 10-16 high
geometry_contract.half_open: rounded black vertical capsule approximately 70 source pixels wide by 45-55 high; visibly taller than half_close but visibly shorter than the V9 open-eye reference; curved top and bottom
geometry_contract.pairing: left/right identical mirrored geometry, same baseline and scale

blink_contract.native_target: each mask fits the V9 eye footprint at 200x200
